title.narrative: Operationalisation of the Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM) - Support to the African Civil Aviation Commission (AFCAC) - Contribution Agreement with EASA

description.narrative: Contract related to: Operationalisation of the Single African Air Transport Market (SAATM) - Support to the African Civil Aviation Commission (AFCAC) - Contribution Agreement with EASA - The Action aims at supporting the operationalisation of the SAATM, and the recommendations of the Aviation cluster of the Transport Task Force, within the scope of the Africa-Europe Alliance for Sustainable Investments and Jobs. The extension of the action is needed because of the justified request from the implementing partner to extend the end date of the activites till 31 august 2026
